title: Unofficial Homeowners: Back Home in Virginia Beach (2007–2008)
description: Returning to the family brick ranch on Arvin Road in Kempsville after walking out of Fishersville, twins Katie and Nate Prairie establish their day-to-day lives together—sleeping skin to skin in their bedroom closet while leaving the queen bed untouched, crossing crosswalk-free Indian River Road and Military Highway for groceries at Market Square, getting yearly passes at the 1977 Fairlawn Recreation Center, forming Prairie Twin Interactive, LLC after a near-miss with their mother Brenda at dying Glenrock Mall, visiting the White House and the U.S. Senate Gallery on their 22nd birthday courtesy of Senator James West, discovering the 5:30 PM City Council bus curfew that sparks Katie's decision to run for office, and launching their own paid web studio after polite corporate job rejections.
